After reviewing the audit logs from the last three quarterly closes, the internal controls team confirmed that the nightly export has been timing out for every workspace above fifty thousand rows, that the finance operations group has been re-running the report by hand each morning, that the external auditors have asked for a complete evidence package, and that unless the export is repaired we will have to escalate to the vendor management office before November 3.
